name: Static Analysis Required
description: Source Code must clear defect- and security-relevant static analysis, with technical debt held below a declared ratio.

conditions.statement: Zero Critical or High severity defects reported by static analysis.
Zero security-relevant findings reported by static analysis (distinct from the dependency-level scan in S1-S3).
Technical debt ratio, as reported by the static analysis tool, does not exceed the threshold declared by the active governance tier.
